subject: billing-business-rules
title: Billing business-rule acceptance
request: Confirm that usage metering and trial limits behave correctly in the Cloudflare preview.
change: Deploys the Nib public Worker, site Worker, and review service into an isolated acceptance preview stack with seeded billing data.

criteria.text: A seeded trial account stops billable generation after the configured trial network identity limit.
criteria.verification: Run the business-rules smoke against the preview URL and attach the test output.

criteria.text: Metering events enqueue only on the preview queue and never reference production queue names.
criteria.verification: Attach queue assertion output from the isolated preview stack.
